$doc: Per-legacy-package file-count ratchet. Each entry caps the .go file count for a flat-parent directory; counts can only DECREASE as the Phase R restructure carves files into subpackages.
* `path` is a repo-relative directory (no trailing slash).
* `max_files` is the maximum allowed count of .go files at the FLAT parent of `path` (subpackages and _test.go files are EXEMPT — they are not counted).
* A regression (new file pushing count above max_files) fails the archmetrics compare step.
* Owners: when you carve another file out of a parent, REDUCE max_files in the same commit. Never increase it — that defeats the ratchet.
Created: 2026-05-28 (Phase A3.3). Source for initial values: tools/archmetrics/baseline.json phase_r_progress.flat_parent_go_files at HEAD 6c858631 (end of Phase R5).
Source of truth coupling: the `path` set MUST match tools/archmetrics/main.go plannedSubpackages. When adding a new hot-spot, update both files in the same commit.
